Builder

Build with SeaBrick

Assemble mats, tubes, towers and bridged courses from the brick family, course by course. Everything you see is generated from the design model and the layouts checked in the 2026 design study.

Drag to orbit · scroll to zoom · click a brick to identify itOpen in the full builder ↗

What the builder shows

Where each brick goes, which shape it is, how courses register (A, B, C) and how rings close. Colour by course or by shape; separate the courses; watch an assembly go together one brick at a time; save a picture of any view.

What it does not show

The connector surfaces, which are not modelled; joint clearance and insertion order, which are still under study; and any load or wave behaviour. For joint behaviour on a two-brick model, see the connection lab.

Units

Dimensions are in brick pitches: one pitch is the centre-to-centre spacing of neighbouring bricks. A course is one brick tall. Tube radius is measured from the centre to a flat wall.
